
```{r}
#| include: false
# Load the exported snapshot and prebuilt widgets. Rendering does not query
# project files, the tracking database, or a scheduler.
library(htmltools)
library(reactable)
library(plotly)
qc <- readRDS(params$snapshot)
widgets <- readRDS(params$widgets)
totals <- widgets$summary$totals
```

## Row {height=350}

::: {.card title="Outputs by stage and stream"}

Counts describe files and derivative records. Supporting upstream inputs are
listed separately from the outputs selected by the snapshot configuration.
One raw BOLD file can yield several spaces, streams, and atlas products.

```{r}
widgets$outputs
```

:::

## Row {height=390}

::: {.card title="Participant summary"}

Click a participant to apply its shared table filter. Counts describe the whole
snapshot; zero output records can mean upstream inputs have not arrived.

```{r}
widgets$participants
```

:::

## Row {height=410}

::: {.card title="Needs attention"}

Each row explains its flags. Expand it to read saved audit messages and follow
original evidence. An empty table means there are no flagged derivative
records; collection issues and untracked workflow units remain separate.

```{r}
widgets$attention
```

:::

```{r}
widgets$workflow_plot
```

### Column {width=35%}

```{r}
#| title: About this snapshot
tags$div(class = "qc-about",
  tags$p(class = "qc-eyebrow", "BRAINGNOMES / QC SNAPSHOT"),
  tags$h3(qc$metadata$project),
  tags$p(tags$strong("Collected: "), qc$metadata$created_at),
  tags$p(tags$strong("Scope: "), if (identical(qc$metadata$scope, "run"))
    paste("Saved run", qc$metadata$run_id) else "Project-wide"),
  tags$p(qc$metadata$expectation_basis),
  tags$p("Current files are observed at collection time. A saved run scope does not reconstruct historical files."),
  tags$p(paste(totals$completed_units, "of", totals$workflow_units,
    "workflow units completed;", totals$job_records, "job records (including controllers and sentinels).")),
  tags$p(if (qc$metadata$scheduler_refreshed) "Active jobs compared with the scheduler at collection time."
    else "Database snapshot; the scheduler was not queried."),
  tags$p("Collect a new snapshot to refresh this dashboard."),
  tags$p(class = "qc-note", "Workflow completion, file availability, and computational QC checks answer different questions. None establishes that an image is scientifically acceptable."),
  tags$div(class = "qc-downloads",
    tags$a(href = "inventory.tsv", download = "inventory.tsv", "Derivative TSV"),
    tags$a(href = "workflow.tsv", download = "workflow.tsv", "Workflow TSV"),
    tags$a(href = "inventory.rds", download = "inventory.rds", "Complete R object"))
)
```

## Row {height=350}

::: {.card title="Processing settings"}

Settings describe the configuration used for expectations. A saved run uses its
recorded settings; existing evidence may come from earlier processing.

```{r}
widgets$settings
```

:::

## Row {height=410}

::: {.card title="Workflow inventory"}

Recorded states are shown alongside configured work with no tracking record.
Units can cover a whole participant/session and several acquisitions. Missing
upstream inputs remain in this table before derivative paths can be resolved.

```{r}
widgets$workflow
```

:::

# Derivatives

## Row {height=620}

::: {.card title="Explore outputs and evidence"}

Search or filter any column, then expand a row for source files, diagnostics,
validation measurements, full messages, and exact output-manifest associations. “Available” means
a nonempty file exists. “Attention” marks missing/empty outputs, failed or
invalid audits, recorded ROI loss, shared destinations, and failed workflow
context. Missing required diagnostics and audit warnings also need attention.
“Not applicable” means that check is disabled or does not apply to the stage;
“unavailable” means its requirement is unknown and no evidence was found.
These flags are navigation aids for human review.

```{r}
widgets$inventory
```

:::

## Row {height=350}

::: {.card title="Raw BOLD acquisitions"}

Raw files are listed separately from derivative records; echoes and acquisition
labels are retained. One acquisition can produce multiple spaces, streams, and
atlas outputs. Derivative counts therefore are not scan counts.

```{r}
widgets$acquisitions
```

:::

# QC metrics

## Row {height=530}

::: {.card title="QC measurements"}

Mean FD combines all tasks in one view, with one point per confounds file;
individual scans are not averaged together. Other metrics retain their
stage/stream/task/atlas comparison groups in the plot menu. Hover for scan
identities, values, units, and observed/missing denominators. Each evidence
source appears once within its group. Values are descriptive; no dashboard
cutoff is applied.

```{r}
widgets$metric_plot
```

:::

## Row {height=400}

::: {.card title="Metric definitions and sources"}

FD comes from the original fMRIPrep confounds. Censor retention describes the
saved mask and does not establish whether volumes were removed. ROI retention
uses the extraction rule saved in the diagnostics. Structured audit measurements include mask replay errors, smoothness, intensity
errors, and spectral attenuation when recorded. These are computational
measurements with their saved units and sampling counts.
MRIQC metrics retain their upstream names and definitions in a separate group.

```{r}
widgets$metrics
```

:::

## Row {height=320}

::: {.card title="Postprocessing validation checks"}

Audits test computational operations. Their timestamps and source files are
retained with each check; an older audit may outlive its derivative.
Participant and acquisition identities support the same table filters as outputs.
Expand a check for its full message, warnings, timings, and scalar details.
Complete structured details, including arrays, are retained in `checks.tsv`.

```{r}
widgets$checks
```

:::

## Row {height=350}

::: {.card title="Regional voxel coverage"}

Filter by participant, stream, atlas, or retained status to locate individual
ROIs with limited usable voxels. The saved reason explains whether a label
fell outside the mask, contained unusable BOLD signal, or missed its threshold.

```{r}
widgets$regions
```

:::

# Workflow & evidence

## Row {.tabset height=520}

::: {.card title="Job attempts"}

Expand a job for stdout/stderr, its submission manifest, and runtime receipt.
Historical attempts are retained. A newer attempt does not establish the origin
of an existing derivative.

```{r}
widgets$jobs
```

:::

::: {.card title="Active jobs"}

```{r}
widgets$active
```

:::

::: {.card title="Scheduler comparison"}

```{r}
widgets$reconciliation
```

:::

::: {.card title="Output manifest checks"}

These checks compare exact paths, sizes, and modification times against saved
job manifests. They do not verify file contents or scientific quality.

```{r}
widgets$manifests
```

Distinct paths and job/file associations are counted separately. The same file
can be listed by a controller and an array job. All associations remain in the
manifest download; exceptions are listed below.

```{r}
widgets$manifest_exceptions
```

:::

## Row {.tabset height=440}

::: {.card title="Evidence library"}

Links open original reports and files. Keep the source project accessible;
moving this dashboard alone does not copy upstream evidence or its assets.

```{r}
widgets$evidence
```

:::

::: {.card title="Collection issues"}

Malformed diagnostics and unresolved associations appear here. Other available
evidence remains accessible; a collection problem does not imply a QC pass.

```{r}
widgets$issues
```

:::

::: {.card title="Downloads & interpretation"}

The HTML includes the displayed tables, plots, and interactive controls. Save it
and open it in a web browser to review offline. To use the download links below,
keep the corresponding TSV/RDS/JSON files beside the HTML. Links to original
evidence require access to those source files.

- [Raw acquisitions](acquisitions.tsv)
- [Derivative inventory](inventory.tsv)
- [Workflow inventory](workflow.tsv)
- [Metric values, definitions, and sources](metrics.tsv)
- [Regional voxel coverage](regions.tsv)
- [Validation checks](checks.tsv)
- [Evidence paths and timestamps](evidence.tsv)
- [Job history](jobs.tsv) and [logical attempts](attempts.tsv)
- [Output manifest checks](manifest_files.tsv)
- [Collection issues](issues.tsv)
- [Complete R object](inventory.rds) and [snapshot metadata](snapshot.json)

All downloads describe the same snapshot. Project-wide expectations use the
current configuration; a saved run scope uses its recorded configuration,
participants, stages, and streams. Files are observed at collection time. Until inputs
exist, workflow expectations provide the denominator; output spaces and echo
combinations are not guessed. Configurations may have changed since a historical
attempt. Consult its saved manifest and receipt for its execution settings.

This dashboard supports inspection and discussion. It does not collect human
ratings, make inclusion decisions, or modify the pipeline.

:::
